public_definitions: The task requires identifying the clean-generation source with the largest contribution from the dashboard chart.
The routing threshold is implicitly defined as the largest contribution source, as any source not meeting this criterion is to be left out of the priority queue.
The 'primary_field_label' 'Contribution routing selection' corresponds to the three options provided: 'Route Utility solar...', 'Route Offshore wind...', and 'Keep Hydro storage...'.
uncertain: The exact routing threshold percentage is not explicitly stated in the task or chart, but the largest contribution source is the only one to be routed.
